title: advertiser_v2_link.v1
description: WHY advertisers@2 merged two ads: one row per (accepted v2 edge, key kind), from the same pair pass that builds advertisers_v2.jsonl. Written by `derive-advertisers --method v2` to derived/advertiser_v2_links.jsonl, ad_a < ad_b. Never ad text: keys follow advertiser_link.v1's conventions.

operator_id.description: the v2 operator both ads belong to (advertiser.v2 operator_id)

link_key.description: phone4 = last 4 digits; handle, name, venue = normalised; title, desc, image (the upload id) = a 12-hex fingerprint, never the text. The smallest key when the pair shares several of this kind.

n_keys.description: how many distinct keys of this kind the pair shares

edge_kinds.description: every kind on this edge: the pair rule's input (>= 1 strong or >= 2 kinds; >= 2 across subcategories)

persona_edge.description: the edge also links personas (a handle, or a name plus another kind)
